name: sample-request
title: Sample request
description: Order free samples before a big purchase: pick up to five swatches, see what is on its way, and add the delivery address in one short form.
docs: swatches are { id, name, color?, image?, note? }: a colour, a picture of the material (a URL or a data URI) or both, each a real checkbox with its name under it. limit (default 5) is the most samples one request can hold; at the limit the rest are switched off and the text beside the counter says why, while the chosen ones stay on so one can always be taken out. The counter ('Samples chosen: 3 of 5') is also the status region. value and onChange control the choice (the ids, in the order they were chosen), defaultValue starts it, and address fills the form for a customer who is signed in. Beside the grid sit the chosen samples, each with a button to take it out (focus moves to the next one), the delivery promise (deliveryNote: 'Free, arrives in 3 to 5 days') and the address. onSubmit({ swatchIds, address }) may return a promise. Return a message and the form stays with the samples and the address in it, and says so in a notice that takes focus; return nothing, or resolve, and the form is replaced by what is coming, where it is going and the order reference (return { reference } to print it). submitted shows that confirmation for a request your page already holds, shopHref adds the link back to the shop, locale writes the numbers, headingAs is 'h3' inside a section that has its own h2, and labels holds the fixed words.
